author_or_institution: Journal of Cachexia, Sarcopenia and Muscle (2026)
title: Exercise and Weekly Sirolimus (Rapamycin) in Older Adults: RAPA-EX-01 Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial
book_use: Chapter 11; The Rapamycin Underground; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: 40 adults aged 65-85 randomized to 6 mg weekly sirolimus or placebo for 13 weeks alongside exercise; no improvement in the primary chair-stand outcome; 99 total adverse events in the sirolimus arm versus 63 with placebo; one possibly drug-related pneumonia; Limits: Small exploratory study of short-term physical adaptation, not a trial of lifespan or major age-related morbidity. It cannot determine long-term longevity benefit.
